children: To make IDBI Bank a leading global Indian bank over time, Canada-based Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd (FFHL) proposes to “contribute” all of its interests in Go Digit Life Insurance and Go Digit General Insurance (collectively, “Digit”) and all its interest in IIFL Capital Services Ltd (IIFL Capital) to the Bank.
FFHL, through its step-down subsidiary “10955230 Canada Inc”, recently emerged as a “Strategic Buyer” for a 60.72 per cent equity stake in the Bank for a purchase consideration of ₹52,878 crore.

Fairfax currently expects the purchase price for the purchase transaction to be satisfied through a combination of cash on hand or otherwise available to Fairfax through existing credit sources and potential asset sales, per an FFHL statement.

title: Fairfax proposes to contribute its interests in Digit, IIFL Capital to IDBI Bank
